name: hardware-address
description: IEEE 802 MAC-48, EUI-48, EUI-64, and InfiniBand hardware addresses for WebAssembly
author: Al Liu <scygliu1@gmail.com>

scripts.build:node: wasm-pack build --target nodejs --features wasm-bindgen --release --out-dir pkg-node --out-name hardware_address -- --locked
scripts.build:web: wasm-pack build --target web --features wasm-bindgen --release --out-dir pkg-web --out-name hardware_address -- --locked
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:node && npm run build:web
